description: GLOBAL_SCRIPT_KEY is defined as '_global' in config.rs and documented as 'the reserved username for the server-wide global Sieve script'. However, sieve_admin.rs user_exists() contains a special-case for GLOBAL_SCRIPT_KEY using a case-insensitive comparison while all other username comparisons are exact-match. The special-casing is not mentioned in the constant's doc comment, creating a hidden behavioral divergence. Fix: add a doc comment on the special-case branch explaining why case-insensitive comparison is used for this key, and add a note to GLOBAL_SCRIPT_KEY's doc comment that it is compared case-insensitively on inbound admin requests.
title: smtp: GLOBAL_SCRIPT_KEY documentation vs behavior inconsistency
